messages:
clare (infosec): Scheduled network hardening in us-west-2 tonight 01:00 UTC. It tightens egress to only approved control-plane endpoints. Heads-up: this might inadvertently block a privatelink used by our HSM-keystore path for GPU nodes.

mohit (infra): Confirmed in staging — new nodes failing KMS/HSM handshake because the privatelink IP was not in the approved list. Error: `hsm: dial tcp x.x.x.57:443: connect: connection refused` then `ephemeral grant unavailable`.

adina (platform): Which CIDR/endpoint is missing? we should scope a fast allowlist vs open everything.

mohit (infra): Missing: `pl-keystore-usw2.prod` behind privatelink NAT 100.64.12.57. Also a legacy bootstrap host `bootstrap-old-2.usw2` that still talks to the HSM for attest.

yusuf (sre): Staging metrics: warm-pool fill dropped 72% -> 38% within 8m when privatelink was blocked. Cold-start latency p95 up ~180ms because we fall back to local grants. Pager alerts fired for `keystore_handshake_error`.

clare (infosec): Compliance will allow a scoped L7 passthrough for the keystore path if you provide: exact hostnames/IPs, justification limited to onboarding/resync jobs, a 12-24h expiry, owner, and extended audit retention for those flows.

adina (platform): Proposal: temporary allowlist only for service account `svc:onboard` and the proxy CIDR 100.64.12.56/29. Timebox 12h. We will canary AZ-by-AZ and revoke automatically after expiry. PR: https://git.redwood/fw-regions/pulls/2002 (draft).

mohit (infra): Canary plan: enable for one AZ, max 4 nodes, run smoke: `curl -sS https://pl-keystore-usw2.prod/health` from boot agent. Toggle: `./ops/fw-toggle --rule fw-usw2-2026 --enable exception:onboarders --az a`.

yusuf (sre): Rollback triggers: warm-pool fill drop >20% over 10m OR keystore 5xx >1% sustained 5m. If hit, revoke immediately and pause backfills. I'll watch metrics and post updates.

clare (infosec): Also need an audit entry and ticket. audit-bot please create a record with PR link, approvers (clare, adina), expiry, and retention bump to 180d.

audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-821 "Scoped privatelink passthrough for HSM-keystore (us-west-2)" assigned to clare (infosec), adina (platform). PR: https://git.redwood/fw-regions/pulls/2002. Expiry: 12h.

adina (platform): I'll finalize the PR and add the auto-revoke job. Merging once clare signs off.

mohit (infra): Merging + starting AZ canary in ~10m. Will post quick metric pings.

clare (infosec): Signed off for 12h. Please include a short post-action note explaining why privatelink wasn't on the baseline and schedule proxy migration to the approved nexus next sprint.

yusuf (sre): Oncall monitoring active. Ping channel on any keystore spikes.

adina (platform): Merged. Starting canary now. :rocket:
